assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Create a production animation sprite sheet from this edit target. Output ONE 2048x1152 PNG containing exactly 2 columns by 2 rows of four equal 1024x576 full-bleed 16:9 frames, zero margins, zero gutters, no labels, no borders. Each cell repeats the SAME fixed-camera workshop shot and same older bearded man with black beanie, glasses, dark jacket. Preserve PS2-era low-poly angular geometry and low-resolution textures, same dark lighting/color, identity, framing and background. Only change his arms/hands and happy engaged expression. An obvious clapping animation: top left hands raised at chest width and apart, top right hands approaching one another at chest center, bottom left palms together clapping at chest center, bottom right hands separating again. Both arms anatomically plausible, low-poly hands, do not cover face, shoulders subtly involved. Face remains registered at exactly the same position in all cells, background static pixel-aligned between frames, no camera motion/zoom. Fit hands fully within each cell. This will be played in a loop in a Three.js wall marquee. No new text, no added objects.

Use case: identity-preserve. Edit the provided character into ONE production animation sprite atlas. EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows, 4 equal full-bleed 16:9 cells in a 16:9 overall PNG; no gutters, no borders, no labels. All four cells show the same woman in a light blouse in the library. Preserve identity, clothing, coarse PS2-era low-poly faceted character shapes, low-resolution textures, original dark color/lighting and the same room background. Four chronological animation poses in reading order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right: clapping: hands apart at chest height; hands approaching; palms touching at chest center; hands separating. Movement clearly visible, not just facial expressions. Keep face center, body size and camera fixed, background pixel-aligned and unchanged across all four frames. Keep both hands anatomically plausible and low-poly, no extra limbs; hands and raised arms fully inside each cell, no covering face. Leave sufficient room above head in all four cells for raised hands. No zoom, no camera shake. This atlas loops as a GIF-like wall animation in Three.js.
